title: Homoplantaginin attenuates high glucose-induced vascular endothelial cell apoptosis through promoting autophagy via the AMPK/TFEB pathway.
authors: Fan, Lili; Zhang, Xueying; Huang, Yihai; Zhang, Baobao; Li, Wenjing; Shi, Qingru; Lin, Yining; Wu, Feihua
one_liner_zh: 研究黄酮化合物Hom通过AMPK/TFEB通路促进自噬减轻高糖诱导的内皮细胞凋亡，仅含分子对接且对象非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Vascular endothelial cell (VEC) injury is a key factor in the development of diabetic vascular complications. Homoplantaginin (Hom), one of the main flavonoids from Salvia plebeia R. Br. has been reported to protect VEC. However, its effects and mechanisms against diabetic vascular endothelium remain unclear. Here, the effect of Hom on VEC was assessed using high glucose (HG)-treated human umbilical vein endothelial cells and db/db mice. In vitro, Hom significantly inhibited apoptosis and promoted autophagosome formation and lysosomal function such as lysosomal membrane permeability and the expression of LAMP1 and cathepsin B. The antiapoptosis effect of Hom was reversed by autophagy inhibitor chloroquine phosphate or bafilomycin A1. Furthermore, Hom promoted gene expression and nuclear translocation of transcription factor EB (TFEB). TFEB gene knockdown attenuated the effect of Hom on upregulating lysosomal function and autophagy. Moreover, Hom activated adenosine monophosphate-dependent protein kinase (AMPK) and inhibited the phosphorylation of mTOR, p70S6K, and TFEB. These effects were attenuated by AMPK inhibitor Compound C. Molecular docking showed a good interaction between Hom and AMPK protein. Animal studies indicated that Hom effectively upregulated the protein expression of p-AMPK and TFEB, enhanced autophagy, reduced apoptosis, and alleviated vascular injury. These findings revealed that Hom ameliorated HG-mediated VEC apoptosis by enhancing autophagy via the AMPK/mTORC1/TFEB pathway.
abstract_zh: 血管内皮细胞（VEC）损伤是糖尿病血管并发症发生的关键因素。同源植物黄酮（Hom），作为荔枝草（Salvia plebeia R. Br.）的主要黄酮类化合物之一，已被报道可保护VEC。然而，其对糖尿病血管内皮的作用及机制仍不清楚。本研究通过高糖（HG）处理的人脐静脉内皮细胞和db/db小鼠评估了Hom对VEC的影响。体外实验显示，Hom显著抑制细胞凋亡，并促进自噬体形成及溶酶体功能，如溶酶体膜通透性以及LAMP1和组织蛋白酶B的表达。Hom的抗凋亡作用被自噬抑制剂氯喹磷酸盐或巴弗洛霉素A1逆转。此外，Hom促进了转录因子EB（TFEB）的基因表达和核转位。TFEB基因敲低减弱了Hom上调溶酶体功能和自噬的作用。进一步研究表明，Hom激活了腺苷酸活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）并抑制mTOR、p70S6K和TFEB的磷酸化。这些效应被AMPK抑制剂Compound C减弱。分子对接显示Hom与AMPK蛋白之间存在良好的相互作用。动物实验表明，Hom有效上调p-AMPK和TFEB的蛋白表达，增强自噬，减少凋亡，并缓解血管损伤。这些发现揭示Hom通过AMPK/mTORC1/TFEB通路增强自噬，从而改善HG介导的VEC凋亡。
